LOGGING_LEVEL_CONSOLE.name: Console log level
LOGGING_LEVEL_CONSOLE.description: 10 = DEBUG, 20 = INFO, 30 = WARNING, 40 = ERROR, 50 = CRITICAL. Use 20 for normal operation.

LOGGING_FILE.name: Log file path
LOGGING_FILE.description: Advanced. The stock image overrides this with /var/log/pai/paradox.log.

LOGGING_FILE_MAX_SIZE.name: Log file size (MB)
LOGGING_FILE_MAX_SIZE.description: Maximum size before rotation. PAI accepts 0-4294967295.

LOGGING_FILE_MAX_FILES.name: Rotated log files
LOGGING_FILE_MAX_FILES.description: Number of old log files to keep. PAI accepts 0-4294967295.

LOGGING_DUMP_PACKETS.name: Debug: dump raw packets
LOGGING_DUMP_PACKETS.description: Leave disabled normally. Captures may contain credentials and private panel data; redact before sharing.

LOGGING_DUMP_MESSAGES.name: Debug: dump messages
LOGGING_DUMP_MESSAGES.description: Leave disabled normally. Messages may expose credentials, including PRT3 disarm codes.

LOGGING_DUMP_STATUS.name: Debug: dump status
LOGGING_DUMP_STATUS.description: Leave disabled normally. Status dumps may contain private panel data.

LOGGING_DUMP_EVENTS.name: Debug: dump events
LOGGING_DUMP_EVENTS.description: Leave disabled normally. Events may contain private user and zone details.

DEVELOPMENT_DUMP_MEMORY.name: Development: dump panel memory
DEVELOPMENT_DUMP_MEMORY.description: For troubleshooting only. Memory dumps may contain sensitive panel data.

CONNECTION_TYPE.name: Panel connection
CONNECTION_TYPE.description: Choose Serial, IP or PRT3, then configure only that connection's fields. Restart after saving.

SERIAL_PORT.name: Serial: device path
SERIAL_PORT.description: For Serial only. Prefer a stable /dev/serial/by-id/... path when available; otherwise use a path such as /dev/ttyUSB0.

SERIAL_BAUD.name: Serial: baud rate
SERIAL_BAUD.description: For Serial only. Must match your panel; commonly 9600, 38400 or 57600. Do not use this field for PRT3.

SERIAL_ENCRYPTED.name: Serial: full-AES encryption
SERIAL_ENCRYPTED.description: Enable only for supported full-AES EVO serial connections. Requires the PC password; does not support compact Babyware encryption.

PRT3_SERIAL_PORT.name: PRT3: device path
PRT3_SERIAL_PORT.description: For PRT3 only. For example /dev/ttyUSB0; prefer a stable /dev/serial/by-id/... path when available.

PRT3_SERIAL_BAUD.name: PRT3: baud rate
PRT3_SERIAL_BAUD.description: Exactly 9600 or 19200, matching the module's DIP switches. Other values within the form's range are rejected by PAI.

PRT3_USER_CODE.name: PRT3: arm/disarm user code
PRT3_USER_CODE.description: Empty = quick-arm only. Otherwise 1-6 decimal digits with permission for the area. Quote in YAML to preserve leading zeros. Debug message dumps may expose this code.

PRT3_MAX_AREAS.name: PRT3: area count
PRT3_MAX_AREAS.description: 1-8. Match your panel to avoid unnecessary polling.

PRT3_MAX_ZONES.name: PRT3: zone count
PRT3_MAX_ZONES.description: 0-192. Zero disables zone polling. Match your panel to reduce startup and polling time.

PRT3_MAX_USERS.name: PRT3: user count
PRT3_MAX_USERS.description: 0-999. Zero disables user-label polling. Large counts can slow startup.

PRT3_COMM_TIMEOUT.name: PRT3: connection timeout (seconds)
PRT3_COMM_TIMEOUT.description: 1-60 seconds to wait for the module's COMM&ok response.

IP_CONNECTION_HOST.name: IP: module host
IP_CONNECTION_HOST.description: For direct IP connections. Hostname or IP address, without http:// or a port; for example 192.168.1.20.

IP_CONNECTION_PORT.name: IP: module port
IP_CONNECTION_PORT.description: 1-65535; normally 10000. Used for the outgoing connection, not the Babyware listening port.

IP_CONNECTION_PASSWORD.name: IP: module password
IP_CONNECTION_PASSWORD.description: The IP module's password, not the panel PC password. Replace the factory default.

IP_CONNECTION_SITEID.name: IP: site ID
IP_CONNECTION_SITEID.description: Optional site-based connection. Leave unset for a direct connection to the module host.

IP_CONNECTION_EMAIL.name: IP: site account email
IP_CONNECTION_EMAIL.description: The email registered for a site-based connection. Not needed for a direct connection.

IP_CONNECTION_PANEL_SERIAL.name: IP: site panel serial
IP_CONNECTION_PANEL_SERIAL.description: Optional panel selection for a multi-panel site. Leave unset to select the first panel.

IP_CONNECTION_BARE.name: IP: bare TCP serial tunnel
IP_CONNECTION_BARE.description: Enable only for a raw panel serial-over-TCP bridge, not a normal IP150/IP100 connection.

KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL.name: Status update interval (seconds)
KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL.description: Time between panel status updates. The add-on default is 10 seconds.

IO_TIMEOUT.name: I/O timeout (seconds)
IO_TIMEOUT.description: Fractional seconds are supported; for example 0.5. Change only when troubleshooting connection timing.

LIMITS.name: Panel discovery limits
LIMITS.description: Per category: auto = default discovery limits; empty = none; IDs/ranges such as 1-8,12 = selected items. Keep existing values unless you intend to change monitoring.

door.name: Doors
door.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none.

pgm.name: Panel PGMs
pgm.description: For example 1-5. Does not configure bus-module PGM addresses.

module.name: Modules
module.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none.

bus-module.name: Bus modules
bus-module.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none. Does not configure module PGM outputs.

repeater.name: Repeaters
repeater.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none.

keypad.name: Keypads
keypad.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none.

key-switch.name: Key switches
key-switch.description: IDs/ranges, auto, or empty for none.

LABEL_ENCODING.name: Panel label encoding
LABEL_ENCODING.description: Normally paradox-en. Use a supported paradox-* or Python text encoding if labels display incorrectly.

LABEL_REFRESH_INTERVAL.name: Label refresh interval (seconds)
LABEL_REFRESH_INTERVAL.description: Zero disables periodic refresh. PAI accepts 0-4294967295; its default is 900 seconds.

OUTPUT_PULSE_DURATION.name: PGM pulse duration (seconds)
OUTPUT_PULSE_DURATION.description: Fractional seconds are supported; for example 0.5. PAI accepts 0-4294967295.

SYNC_TIME.name: Synchronize panel clock
SYNC_TIME.description: For supported native Serial/IP panels. PRT3 does not support clock synchronization.

SYNC_TIME_MIN_DRIFT.name: Clock drift threshold (seconds)
SYNC_TIME_MIN_DRIFT.description: PAI requires at least 120 seconds. Synchronize when the panel clock differs by more than this threshold.

SYNC_TIME_TIMEZONE.name: Panel timezone
SYNC_TIME_TIMEZONE.description: Empty uses the host timezone. Otherwise use an IANA name such as Europe/Helsinki.

PASSWORD.name: Panel PC communication password
PASSWORD.description: Not a user/master/installer code. Native SP/MG/EVO normally uses 4 hexadecimal characters; empty/short values remain supported. MG6250 uses 1-255 UTF-8 bytes. Quote in YAML to preserve zeros. Unused by PRT3.

MG6250_USERNAME.name: MG6250: PC username
MG6250_USERNAME.description: Normally admin. MG6250 support in 3.8.1 is limited to login/decryption, not usable monitoring or control.

PUSH_UPDATE_WITHOUT_CHANGE.name: Publish unchanged panel updates
PUSH_UPDATE_WITHOUT_CHANGE.description: Advanced. Notify interfaces even when values have not changed; increases traffic.

MQTT_ENABLE.name: Enable MQTT
MQTT_ENABLE.description: Required for MQTT monitoring/control and Home Assistant MQTT discovery.

MQTT_HOST.name: MQTT: broker host
MQTT_HOST.description: Hostname or IP, without a scheme or port. For the Home Assistant Mosquitto add-on use core-mosquitto.

MQTT_PORT.name: MQTT: broker port
MQTT_PORT.description: 1-65535; normally 1883, or the broker's TLS port when a CA certificate is configured.

MQTT_TRANSPORT.name: MQTT: transport
MQTT_TRANSPORT.description: tcp for normal MQTT; websockets only if your broker provides a WebSocket endpoint.

MQTT_PROTOCOL.name: MQTT: protocol version
MQTT_PROTOCOL.description: Normally 3.1.1. Choose a version supported by your broker; quote the value in YAML.

MQTT_QOS.name: MQTT: quality of service
MQTT_QOS.description: 0 = at most once, 1 = at least once, 2 = exactly once. Default: 0.

MQTT_TLS_CERT_PATH.name: MQTT: CA certificate path
MQTT_TLS_CERT_PATH.description: Path inside the container to the CA certificate. Omit when not using TLS. A host path must be available through a mapped directory.

MQTT_USERNAME.name: MQTT: username
MQTT_USERNAME.description: Broker login username. Must match an account authorized to use the configured topics.

MQTT_PASSWORD.name: MQTT: password
MQTT_PASSWORD.description: Broker login password. Replace the example password; quote numeric-looking values in YAML.

MQTT_RETAIN.name: MQTT: retain published messages
MQTT_RETAIN.description: Allows new subscribers to receive the latest retained values. Raw events can also remain retained.

MQTT_BIND_ADDRESS.name: MQTT: local bind address
MQTT_BIND_ADDRESS.description: Advanced. The stock image overrides this with 0.0.0.0; it is not the broker host.

MQTT_BIND_PORT.name: MQTT: local bind port
MQTT_BIND_PORT.description: Advanced. The stock image overrides this with 18839; it is not the broker port.

MQTT_REPUBLISH_INTERVAL.name: MQTT: republish interval (seconds)
MQTT_REPUBLISH_INTERVAL.description: PAI requires at least 60 seconds. Its default is 43200 seconds (12 hours).

MQTT_PUBLISH_DEFINITIONS.name: MQTT: publish definitions
MQTT_PUBLISH_DEFINITIONS.description: Publish panel element definitions below the definition topic.

MQTT_BASE_TOPIC.name: MQTT: base topic
MQTT_BASE_TOPIC.description: Root topic for this instance. Defaults: paradox for the first instance, paradox2 for the second. Keep instances distinct; avoid + and # wildcards.

MQTT_ZONE_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: zones
MQTT_ZONE_TOPIC.description: Zone-state subtopic below the base topic; normally zones. Avoid + and # wildcards.

MQTT_CONTROL_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: control
MQTT_CONTROL_TOPIC.description: Command subtopic; normally control. Restrict command publishing using broker ACLs.

MQTT_DEFINITION_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: definitions
MQTT_DEFINITION_TOPIC.description: Definition subtopic; normally definitions. This singular setting name is the one PAI reads.

MQTT_DEFINITIONS_TOPIC.name: Deprecated: definitions topic (ignored)
MQTT_DEFINITIONS_TOPIC.description: Retained only for saved-configuration compatibility. PAI ignores this spelling; use MQTT_DEFINITION_TOPIC instead.

MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_CONTROL_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: Home Assistant control
MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_CONTROL_TOPIC.description: Home Assistant command subtopic; normally hass_control.

MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_DISCOVERY_PREFIX.name: Home Assistant: discovery prefix
MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_DISCOVERY_PREFIX.description: Must match Home Assistant's MQTT discovery prefix; normally homeassistant.

MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_ENTITY_PREFIX.name: Home Assistant: entity name prefix
MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_ENTITY_PREFIX.description: Optional; for example Paradox {serial_number} . Supports {serial_number} and {model}. Empty adds no prefix.

MQTT_RAW_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: raw events
MQTT_RAW_TOPIC.description: Raw-event subtopic; normally raw under the events topic. Events may contain private data.

MQTT_SEND_PANIC_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: panic commands
MQTT_SEND_PANIC_TOPIC.description: Panic-command subtopic; normally panic. Restrict access using broker ACLs.

MQTT_UTILITY_KEY_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: PRT3 utility keys
MQTT_UTILITY_KEY_TOPIC.description: PRT3 only; normally utility_key. Commands are not protected by MQTT challenge authorization; use broker ACLs.

MQTT_PUBLISH_RAW_EVENTS.name: MQTT: publish raw events
MQTT_PUBLISH_RAW_EVENTS.description: Raw events may contain private data and can be retained when retain is enabled.

MQTT_PREFIX_DEVICE_NAME.name: Home Assistant: prefix device names
MQTT_PREFIX_DEVICE_NAME.description: Add the panel identifier to device names to distinguish multiple panels.

MQTT_CHALLENGE_SECRET.name: MQTT: command challenge secret
MQTT_CHALLENGE_SECRET.description: Optional shared secret for compatible command clients. Not all command paths use this authorization; retain broker ACLs.

MQTT_CHALLENGE_TOPIC.name: MQTT topic: authorization challenge
MQTT_CHALLENGE_TOPIC.description: Challenge subtopic; normally challenge. Must match the command client's configuration.

MQTT_CHALLENGE_ROUNDS.name: MQTT: challenge hash rounds
MQTT_CHALLENGE_ROUNDS.description: Positive integer; default 1000. Must match the command client.

MQTT_USE_NUMERIC_STATES.name: MQTT: numeric boolean states
MQTT_USE_NUMERIC_STATES.description: Use 0/1 instead of True/False. Leave disabled with built-in Home Assistant discovery, which expects True/False.

MQTT_PUBLISH_COMMAND_STATUS.name: MQTT: publish command results
MQTT_PUBLISH_COMMAND_STATUS.description: Publish command outcome messages to the command-status topic.

MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_AUTODISCOVERY_ENABLE.name: Home Assistant: MQTT discovery
MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_AUTODISCOVERY_ENABLE.description: Create supported entities automatically. Requires MQTT enabled and Home Assistant connected to the same broker.

MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_CODE.name: Home Assistant: alarm entity code
MQTT_HOMEASSISTANT_CODE.description: Optional Home Assistant code, not the panel PC password or PRT3 user code. Empty disables this code. Quote in YAML to preserve leading zeros.

MQTT_DASH_PUBLISH.name: MQTT Dash: publish configuration
MQTT_DASH_PUBLISH.description: Optional MQTT Dash integration. Leave disabled if unused.

MQTT_DASH_TEMPLATE.name: MQTT Dash: template path
MQTT_DASH_TEMPLATE.description: Template file path inside the container. The file must exist and be readable.

COMMAND_ALIAS.name: Text-command aliases
COMMAND_ALIAS.description: Replacement commands for the supported aliases. Supervisor accepts only the listed keys.

MQTT_COMMAND_ALIAS.name: MQTT-command aliases
MQTT_COMMAND_ALIAS.description: Maps integration state names to panel commands. Supervisor accepts only the listed keys.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLE.name: Notifications: enable Home Assistant
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLE.description: Send notifications through the Home Assistant API.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_API_TOKEN.name: Notifications: API token
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_API_TOKEN.description: Normally leave unset under Supervisor; its token is used automatically. Needed for a custom external Home Assistant API.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_LOVELACE_URI.name: Notifications: dashboard link
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_LOVELACE_URI.description: Optional URI opened when a notification is clicked.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_NOTIFIER_NAM.name: Notifications: notifier service
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_NOTIFIER_NAM.description: Service name within the notify domain, such as notify or mobile_app_my_phone. Do not include notify. before the name.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_MIN_EVENT_LE.name: Notifications: minimum event level
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_MIN_EVENT_LE.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. PAI default: INFO.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_EVENT_FILTER.name: Notifications: tag filters
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_EVENT_FILTER.description: For example live,alarm,-restore. Clear this list before using allow/ignore regex lists; the modes cannot be combined.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_ALLOW_EVENTS.name: Notifications: allow regexes
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_ALLOW_EVENTS.description: Advanced regex list. First clear the event tag filters. Tuple-style numeric event pairs are not supported by this form.

HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_IGNORE_EVENT.name: Notifications: ignore regexes
HOMEASSISTANT_NOTIFICATIONS_IGNORE_EVENT.description: Advanced regex list. First clear the event tag filters; do not combine the two filter modes.

HOMEASSISTANT_PUBLISH_PARTITION_PROPERTI.name: Home Assistant: partition properties
HOMEASSISTANT_PUBLISH_PARTITION_PROPERTI.description: Normally target_state and current_state. Changing this list changes which partition properties are published.

HOMEASSISTANT_PUBLISH_ZONE_PROPERTIES.name: Home Assistant: zone properties
HOMEASSISTANT_PUBLISH_ZONE_PROPERTIES.description: Normally open and tamper. Changing this list changes which zone properties are published.

PUSHBULLET_KEY.name: Pushbullet: API token
PUSHBULLET_KEY.description: Service-issued access token. Leave unset if the interface is disabled.

PUSHBULLET_DEVICE.name: Pushbullet: device name
PUSHBULLET_DEVICE.description: Name used for the Pushbullet device; normally pai.

PUSHBULLET_CONTACTS.name: Pushbullet: contacts
PUSHBULLET_CONTACTS.description: Pushbullet user identifiers allowed to interact and receive notifications. Add only trusted contacts.

PUSHBULLET_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.name: Pushbullet: minimum event level
PUSHBULLET_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. PAI default: INFO.

PUSHBULLET_EVENT_FILTERS.name: Pushbullet: tag filters
PUSHBULLET_EVENT_FILTERS.description: For example live,alarm,-restore. Clear this list before using allow/ignore regex lists.

PUSHBULLET_ALLOW_EVENTS.name: Pushbullet: allow regexes
PUSHBULLET_ALLOW_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list; numeric event tuples are not supported by this form.

PUSHBULLET_IGNORE_EVENTS.name: Pushbullet: ignore regexes
PUSHBULLET_IGNORE_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list.

PUSHOVER_KEY.name: Pushover: application token
PUSHOVER_KEY.description: Application/API token issued by Pushover, not a recipient user key.

PUSHOVER_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.name: Pushover: minimum event level
PUSHOVER_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. CRITICAL uses emergency priority with repeated notifications.

PUSHOVER_EVENT_FILTERS.name: Pushover: tag filters
PUSHOVER_EVENT_FILTERS.description: For example live,alarm,-restore. Clear this list before using allow/ignore regex lists.

PUSHOVER_ALLOW_EVENTS.name: Pushover: allow regexes
PUSHOVER_ALLOW_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list; numeric event tuples are not supported by this form.

PUSHOVER_IGNORE_EVENTS.name: Pushover: ignore regexes
PUSHOVER_IGNORE_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list.

PUSHOVER_BROADCAST_KEYS.name: Pushover: recipients
PUSHOVER_BROADCAST_KEYS.description: One entry per user/group key. Each entry needs both a user key and devices selector; use * for all devices. Remove unused entries.

user_key.name: User or group key
user_key.description: Recipient key issued by Pushover. Not the application token.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Use * for all devices, or a comma-separated list of device names.

SIGNAL_ENABLE.name: Signal: enable (extra dependencies required)
SIGNAL_ENABLE.description: The stock image lacks the required D-Bus/Python dependencies. Enabling this alone is insufficient.

SIGNAL_CONTACTS.name: Signal: contacts
SIGNAL_CONTACTS.description: Trusted contacts allowed to control the panel and receive notifications.

SIGNAL_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.name: Signal: minimum event level
SIGNAL_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. PAI default: INFO.

SIGNAL_EVENT_FILTERS.name: Signal: tag filters
SIGNAL_EVENT_FILTERS.description: For example live,alarm,-restore. Clear this list before using allow/ignore regex lists.

SIGNAL_ALLOW_EVENTS.name: Signal: allow regexes
SIGNAL_ALLOW_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list; numeric event tuples are not supported by this form.

SIGNAL_IGNORE_EVENTS.name: Signal: ignore regexes
SIGNAL_IGNORE_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list.

GSM_ENABLE.name: GSM: enable SMS interface
GSM_ENABLE.description: Requires a compatible accessible serial modem and trusted contacts.

GSM_MODEM_BAUDRATE.name: GSM: modem baud rate
GSM_MODEM_BAUDRATE.description: PAI accepts 9600-115200. Must match the modem; PAI default: 115200.

GSM_MODEM_PORT.name: GSM: modem device path
GSM_MODEM_PORT.description: Serial modem path inside the container; not the alarm panel's serial port.

GSM_CONTACTS.name: GSM: contacts
GSM_CONTACTS.description: Trusted SMS contacts allowed to control the panel and receive notifications.

GSM_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.name: GSM: minimum event level
GSM_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. PAI default: CRITICAL.

GSM_EVENT_FILTERS.name: GSM: tag filters
GSM_EVENT_FILTERS.description: Clear this list before using allow/ignore regex lists.

GSM_ALLOW_EVENTS.name: GSM: allow regexes
GSM_ALLOW_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list; numeric event tuples are not supported by this form.

GSM_IGNORE_EVENTS.name: GSM: ignore regexes
GSM_IGNORE_EVENTS.description: Advanced. Requires an empty event tag-filter list.

IP_INTERFACE_ENABLE.name: Babyware: enable IP interface
IP_INTERFACE_ENABLE.description: Allow trusted Babyware clients through PAI. Disabled by default. Restrict network access; do not expose to the internet.

IP_INTERFACE_BIND_ADDRESS.name: Babyware: listen address
IP_INTERFACE_BIND_ADDRESS.description: Address inside the container; normally 0.0.0.0. Use Home Assistant's network settings to choose the exposed host port.

IP_INTERFACE_BIND_PORT.name: Babyware: listen port
IP_INTERFACE_BIND_PORT.description: Normally 10000, matching the container port mapping. Changing this alone does not change the published host port.

IP_INTERFACE_PASSWORD.name: Babyware: interface password
IP_INTERFACE_PASSWORD.description: Password clients use to connect to PAI, not the upstream IP module or panel PC password. Replace the factory default.

DUMMY_INTERFACE_ENABLE.name: Development: enable dummy interface
DUMMY_INTERFACE_ENABLE.description: Event-logging interface for troubleshooting, not a simulated alarm panel.

DUMMY_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.name: Development: dummy event level
DUMMY_MIN_EVENT_LEVEL.description: Use DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL.

DUMMY_EVENT_FILTERS.name: Development: dummy tag filters
DUMMY_EVENT_FILTERS.description: Tag expressions for the dummy event-logging interface.

network.10000/tcp: Optional Babyware access through PAI. If enabled, choose a unique host port per instance and allow only trusted clients.
